## Description (paste as plain text)

Ring in 2027 with an animated New Year's Eve invitation your guests open like a real envelope, followed by a gold "3… 2… 1…" countdown and fireworks. Edit it in minutes with no code, then share one link by WhatsApp, text or email.

👀 TRY THE LIVE DEMO
Scan the QR code in the first photo with your phone camera to open the real invitation.

✨ WHAT YOUR GUESTS SEE
• A black envelope with a gold border and a gold "2027" seal. One tap breaks the seal and the card slides out
• A big gold "3… 2… 1…" countdown, then "Happy New Year!" with gold fireworks and confetti
• Slowly falling gold confetti and twinkling hanging stars
• A live countdown to your party
• Date, time and address, with one-tap Google Maps directions
• Add to calendar (Apple, Google, Outlook)
• Dress code with colour suggestions and a gold badge
• Evening schedule, menu and a "Midnight Toast" section (turn any section on or off)
• Built-in RSVP: guests choose yes or no, the number of guests and dietary notes
• Optional music: a built-in Auld Lang Syne music box, or your own MP3. It only plays when a guest taps the music button

🖤 ELEGANT BLACK & GOLD
Midnight black, gold and champagne with elegant serif titles. Looks stunning on phones and computers.

🥂 FOR ANY NEW YEAR CELEBRATION
The wording adapts automatically for: New Year's Eve Party, New Year's Eve Dinner, Countdown Party, Office New Year Party, Masquerade Ball and New Year's Day Brunch. You can also write your own text.

📩 RSVPS STRAIGHT TO YOUR PHONE
Choose how replies reach you:
• WhatsApp: the guest's reply opens as a ready-to-send message to your number
• Email: the reply opens as a ready-to-send email to you
• Your own form link (for example a Google Form)
No account, no app and no monthly fees.

🖥 SO EASY TO EDIT
Open the editor in your browser and fill in a simple form. The invitation updates live as you type. Add your own photo, change every word, and save your draft to come back later. No coding and nothing to install.

✅ HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files
2. Open the editor on a computer and fill in your details
3. Download your finished invitation
4. Publish it with Canva (step-by-step guide included) to get your link
5. Share your link by WhatsApp, text message or email

📦 WHAT YOU GET
• Easy editor (editor.html)
• Invitation template (index.html)
• Step-by-step PDF guide

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
• Use a computer (laptop or desktop) to edit. Guests can open the invitation on any phone or computer.
• You need a Canva account to publish your invitation.
• RSVPs arrive by WhatsApp, email or your own form. There is no guest list dashboard.
• For personal use. Please do not resell or share the files.
• I created this invitation and its editor with the help of AI tools.
• Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is unclear, send me a message and I'll gladly help.

Cheers to 2027! 🥂
